_readme: Edit this file to change what the app shows. Each video is listed once with a provider, any number of topics, and for Sesame Street a 'cast' of character ids from 'characters'; the app filters by any combination of show, topic, era and character. Era comes from the first year in 'airs'. 'cues' maps a character id to the second where that character first shows up, for videos where that is known; the app starts there when that character is the filter. Sesame Street entries aired in 1999 or earlier. 'src' notes official vs fan upload - fan uploads of classic material can be taken down, so a dead thumbnail means re-sourcing it.
